integrity: The source supplies the line equations, common weak combinatorics, and homological types. The new symmetry claim is established by exact algebraic reconstruction of intersection lattices and exhaustive testing of every lattice automorphism for projective realizability.
scientific_limitations: The statement concerns exactly the two thirteen-line complex realizations displayed in Examples 3.1 and 3.2 of arXiv:2407.07070v1. It does not classify their full realization spaces or claim a causal relation between symmetry and freeness.
title: Symmetry jump in the minimal 13-line Numerical Terao pair
